title: Wall Mount Shower Basket 18.75-Inch Solid Brass Wire, Oval Combination | Autumn Sparkle | Allied Brass
short_title: Wall Mount Shower Basket 18.75-Inch | Allied Brass, Autumn Sparkle
description:
Add organized storage to your shower with this wall mount oval combination shower basket crafted from solid brass and ventilated wire for drainage in Autumn Sparkle, which captures the rich, warm tones of fall foliage with subtle shimmer, bringing seasonal warmth year-round. Designed for traditional bathroom hardware looks, it helps keep bottles and soap within reach while saving space.

Highlights:
- Autumn Sparkle transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean, finished look
- Available in a wide variety of designer finish options, including statement colors
- Limited Lifetime Warranty

Specs:
- Category: Basket
- Style: Traditional
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Dimensions: 18.75-Inch L x 4.13-Inch W x 2.25-Inch H (Projection: 4.13-Inch)
- Weight: 4.8 lb
- Included: Basket and all installation hardware
- Assembly required: No
